name: IPL Playoff Predictor
summary: High-performance IPL playoff predictor with dual C++ simulation engines, Python REST API, Docker containerization, and automated daily data updates via GitHub Actions.
highlights: Built two C++ simulation engines optimized for different match counts.
Designed REST API with probability endpoints and status management.
Implemented automated 4x daily data updates during IPL season.
Containerized with Docker and set up CI/CD pipelines for deployment.

name: Certificate Management System
summary: A full-stack system to issue, renew, revoke, and validate certificates through role-based workflows.
highlights: Built end-to-end certificate lifecycle workflows for issuance, renewal, revocation, and verification.
Developed REST APIs and integrated them with a React frontend for operational and validation flows.
Implemented reliable data handling for certificate states and status tracking in MongoDB.

name: Rule Definition Engine
summary: A configurable engine with form-based rule authoring to automate candidate task allotment.
highlights: Built a dynamic UI for creating and managing rule definitions through reusable form components.
Integrated React frontend with Spring Boot services for rule execution and persistence.
Reduced candidate task allotment effort by automating assignment logic through configurable rules.

name: Diabetes Prediction Application
summary: An ML-powered diabetes prediction app that estimates risk from clinical inputs such as age, BMI, glucose, and insulin.
highlights: Built predictive models using Naive Bayes and Perceptron architectures.
Achieved up to 98.36% accuracy across model variants on the dataset.
Created a simple visualization-driven frontend for interactive prediction outputs.

name: LendVault
summary: A decentralized NFT-collateralized peer-to-peer lending platform on Ethereum Sepolia where borrowers use NFTs to secure ETH loans and lenders earn yield.
highlights: Built end-to-end borrowing and lending workflows including loan creation, funding, repayment, and liquidation.
Integrated smart contracts with MetaMask using Ethers.js and enforced collateral escrow with automated default handling.
Implemented backend APIs and database models for users, loans, collateral, and on-chain transaction tracking.
Added real-time platform statistics, risk-aware loan views, and dashboard tracking for active and historical loans.
